title: Google Ads Coach | Top Rated 1:1 PPC Coach | Scott Redgate

facts.fact: Scott Redgate's vendor page says he has 15+ years of Google Ads experience.
facts.quote: get direct access to my 15+ years of Google Ads experience.

facts.fact: The page says the target audience is small and mid-sized businesses using Google Ads for leads, sales, or bookings.
facts.quote: Small and mid-sized businesses using Google Ads for leads, sales, or bookings.

facts.fact: The page offers 1-on-1 coaching sessions, booked through a checkout link, and does not state a price for them.
facts.quote: Book a 1 on 1 coaching session here

facts.fact: The coaching process is described as a four-step sequence, starting with a Deep-Dive Audit conducted on Google Meet.
facts.quote: Deep-Dive Audit – We walk through your account together on Google Meet

facts.fact: The page includes a 'Join Our Free Trial' section, but it gives no trial length, price, or terms.
The page displays two client testimonials about Google Ads coaching with Scott Redgate.
facts.quote: Scott helped me cut through the noise and finally take control of our ad spend.

facts.fact: The page features three recent Google Ads videos from Scott Redgate's YouTube channel.
facts.quote: Recent Google Ads Videos From My YouTube Channel
